records.purpose: Move OpenClaw agent events into bounded Redis observability streams.
records.useWhen: Use it when OpenClaw hook activity must become durable agent evidence.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for Nova pipeline events or lifecycle control.
records.criticalLimit: It depends on configured Redis streams and does not own pipeline state.

records.purpose: Guide read-only diagnosis across Kubernetes, Argo CD, logs, and Hubble evidence.
records.useWhen: Use it when a Codex operator must correlate platform symptoms without making changes.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to deploy, restart, patch, or delete platform resources.
records.criticalLimit: The plugin supplies a skill, but it does not supply the external read-only tools.
records.deploymentNote: Codex installs this package separately; KubeClaw runtime-role manifests do not contain it.

records.purpose: Expose Prism design-set and revision commits as OpenClaw tools.
records.useWhen: Use it when the Prism agent must submit validated design output to Prism control.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a general HTTP client or a Nova pipeline stage.
records.criticalLimit: It requires the Prism control service and accepts exactly the declared tool schemas.
records.deploymentNote: The Prism agent image copies this extension directly; the runtime-role manifest does not list it.

records.purpose: Project agent-observability records into ingestion and evidence observer flows.
records.useWhen: Use it when committed agent records must enter the pipeline observability boundary.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to collect OpenClaw hooks directly.
records.criticalLimit: It observes committed records and cannot change canonical lifecycle state.

records.purpose: Run ordered API flow checks as a Buster test provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when several HTTP operations form one stateful test scenario.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for one independent request or OpenAPI-wide operation discovery.
records.criticalLimit: Flow state exists only inside the bounded provider execution.

records.purpose: Validate architecture deliverables before later pipeline work uses them.
records.useWhen: Use it when a graph needs an explicit architecture acceptance step.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to create the architecture or replace human approval.
records.criticalLimit: It evaluates declared architecture input and does not inspect undeclared repository context.

records.purpose: Provide controlled artifact reads and writes through the capability boundary.
records.useWhen: Use it when a stage or provider must exchange durable bounded artifacts.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as arbitrary filesystem access or as canonical pipeline state.
records.criticalLimit: Every operation remains subject to the granted artifact capability constraints.

records.purpose: Run Axe accessibility checks through the Buster provider contract.
records.useWhen: Use it when rendered web content needs automated accessibility findings.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a complete manual accessibility review.
records.criticalLimit: Its result covers Axe-detectable rules in the tested page state only.

records.purpose: Synchronize approved blueprint content into the implementation workspace.
records.useWhen: Use it when an approved blueprint must become a bounded repository change.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to approve unreviewed architecture or arbitrary files.
records.criticalLimit: The stage is constrained by its declared blueprint and repository inputs.

records.purpose: Request and interpret a Buster quality result in the Nova graph.
records.useWhen: Use it when later Nova work must wait for an exact remote test plan result.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to execute provider tests inside Nova.
records.criticalLimit: Buster owns test execution; Nova imports only the bound result and evidence.

records.purpose: Create the case-study deliverable at its ordered pipeline point.
records.useWhen: Use it when a completed delivery needs the declared showcase narrative.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as general documentation generation.
records.criticalLimit: It produces only the outputs declared by its stage contract.

records.purpose: Provide bounded command execution to granted consumers.
records.useWhen: Use it when an installed extension must run an approved local command.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to expose an unrestricted shell to project input.
records.criticalLimit: Command, environment, duration, and output remain inside operator grants.

records.purpose: Run a BuildKit container build as a Buster provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test plan must prove that a declared image can build.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for untracked deployment or arbitrary daemon control.
records.criticalLimit: It depends on the configured BuildKit service and bounded build context.

records.purpose: Compare LCOV coverage facts with declared quality budgets.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test plan must enforce measurable coverage thresholds.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to run tests or infer coverage without an LCOV report.
records.criticalLimit: The decision is only as complete as the supplied LCOV data.

records.purpose: Check delivery metadata and files before release-oriented work continues.
records.useWhen: Use it when a graph needs a dedicated delivery-contract lint step.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for source-code lint rules owned by the main lint plugin.
records.criticalLimit: It checks the declared delivery surface, not every repository convention.

records.purpose: Exercise the demo authentication session as a Buster provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when the demo path needs a focused authenticated smoke check.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a general identity-provider security assessment.
records.criticalLimit: It validates the configured demo session path and its available environment only.

records.purpose: Move demo candidates through readiness, delivery, and handoff boundaries.
records.useWhen: Use it when the Nova graph needs the complete declared demo handoff flow.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a generic transport or approval mechanism.
records.criticalLimit: Its three stages and adapter share one package-specific handoff contract.

records.purpose: Run one declared command as a Buster test provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test plan needs a bounded command and its evidence.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for long-lived services or unrestricted shell sessions.
records.criticalLimit: Retry safety depends on the command behavior declared by the plan.

records.purpose: Provide controlled Git workspace operations to pipeline extensions.
records.useWhen: Use it when a stage needs an approved repository read or change operation.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to bypass repository grants or package installation controls.
records.criticalLimit: Repository root, operation, and writable scope remain grant-bound.

records.purpose: Run one bounded HTTP request as a Buster provider.
records.useWhen: Use it for an independent endpoint check with explicit expectations.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for a multi-step stateful API flow.
records.criticalLimit: Network reach and request behavior remain inside the resolved provider plan.

records.purpose: Pause a graph for general or architecture-specific human approval.
records.useWhen: Use it when policy requires a recorded person to approve continuation.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as automated validation or as a hidden default approval.
records.criticalLimit: The stage waits for an external decision and cannot manufacture approval.

records.purpose: Run the declared implementation-agent work at the implementation stage.
records.useWhen: Use it when an approved plan is ready for bounded agent implementation.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it before required design and approval evidence exists.
records.criticalLimit: The stage receives only its declared context and capability grants.

records.purpose: Normalize JUnit XML into the Buster report contract.
records.useWhen: Use it when a provider emits JUnit-compatible test results.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to execute tests or decide quality policy.
records.criticalLimit: Malformed, oversized, or unsupported JUnit input must fail normalization.

records.purpose: Prepare and clean a Kubernetes fixture for Buster tests.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test requires a bounded temporary Kubernetes deployment.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for permanent application deployment.
records.criticalLimit: Fixture ownership and cleanup apply only to the resolved test plan scope.

records.purpose: Run Lighthouse web-quality checks as a Buster provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when a rendered page needs performance and quality measurements.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a load test or server-capacity measure.
records.criticalLimit: Results depend on the tested page, runner environment, and configured categories.

records.purpose: Run pre-check and full lint stages through a controlled lint executor.
records.useWhen: Use it when Nova must apply the installed repository lint rule set.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for delivery-only checks or arbitrary command execution.
records.criticalLimit: Rule coverage follows the installed lint configuration and executor grant.

records.purpose: Provide grant-controlled HTTP effects to pipeline extensions.
records.useWhen: Use it when a stage or observer needs an approved outbound HTTP call.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a Buster HTTP test provider.
records.criticalLimit: Destinations, methods, payloads, and response bounds follow operator grants.

records.purpose: Deliver selected committed events to notification and preview targets.
records.useWhen: Use it when operators need asynchronous lifecycle notifications.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to block or alter the source pipeline event.
records.criticalLimit: Delivery failure affects the observer attempt, not canonical pipeline history.

records.purpose: Check declared OpenAPI operations through the Buster provider boundary.
records.useWhen: Use it when API behavior must agree with an OpenAPI description.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for an unrelated HTTP smoke request.
records.criticalLimit: Coverage includes only selected operations and supplied runtime access.

records.purpose: Read bounded OpenClaw agent-event records for Nova consumers.
records.useWhen: Use it when a pipeline stage needs approved agent evidence from the event source.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to install OpenClaw hooks or write arbitrary Redis data.
records.criticalLimit: It reads through its declared source capability and configured record bounds.

records.purpose: Provide controlled messages from pipeline work to an operator channel.
records.useWhen: Use it when a stage must request or report operator-visible information.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as canonical approval state or general transport.
records.criticalLimit: Delivery authority and destination remain operator-controlled.

records.purpose: Run the pipeline review stage and retrieve its bounded review evidence.
records.useWhen: Use it when the graph needs the installed pipeline-specific review workflow.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for the broader repository audit stages.
records.criticalLimit: Its stage and evidence adapter share one review-specific contract.

records.purpose: Run browser scenarios through Playwright in a Buster provider.
records.useWhen: Use it when behavior requires a real browser and page interaction.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for a simple HTTP status or API-only check.
records.criticalLimit: Browser, evidence, network, and execution time remain plan-bound.

records.purpose: Validate preflight inputs and resolve their approved source before work starts.
records.useWhen: Use it when the graph must reject incomplete or inconsistent initial contracts.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for later repository quality or delivery lint.
records.criticalLimit: The two stages validate only the declared preflight and source contracts.

records.purpose: Request and import Prism design work as an ordered Nova stage.
records.useWhen: Use it when the graph requires a Prism design result before implementation.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to expose Prism OpenClaw tools directly.
records.criticalLimit: The stage depends on the configured Prism service and versioned result contract.

records.purpose: Create the declared project summary from completed pipeline evidence.
records.useWhen: Use it when the graph needs a final bounded summary artifact.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a substitute for source evidence or detailed reports.
records.criticalLimit: It summarizes the inputs supplied by the graph and cannot recover omitted facts.

records.purpose: Publish transport and telemetry records through configured Redis channels.
records.useWhen: Use it when Nova extensions need the installed Redis transport boundary.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a general Redis client or canonical state store.
records.criticalLimit: Channel, payload, timeout, and credential behavior follow adapter configuration.

records.purpose: Submit exact remote test plans and retrieve their evidence for Nova.
records.useWhen: Use it when Nova delegates test execution to the Buster boundary.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to run provider code inside the Nova process.
records.criticalLimit: Plan and evidence identities must remain bound across remote execution.

records.purpose: Provide repository operations for Nova through an explicit adapter contract.
records.useWhen: Use it when Nova stages need the installed repository abstraction.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for arbitrary host filesystem access.
records.criticalLimit: It exposes only declared repository operations and granted roots.

records.purpose: Run review, repository audit, and repository revalidation stages.
records.useWhen: Use it when the graph needs the full installed review lifecycle.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for the narrower pipeline-review contract.
records.criticalLimit: Each stage has a distinct type and must appear at the correct graph point.

records.purpose: Dispatch bounded runtime and OpenClaw work through approved runtime targets.
records.useWhen: Use it when an extension must call an installed specialist runtime.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to let project input select arbitrary processes.
records.criticalLimit: Target identity, request, timeout, and result remain capability-bound.

records.purpose: Resolve secret references without exposing the backing secret store.
records.useWhen: Use it when an extension needs an approved secret value at runtime.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to place literal secrets in project or plugin configuration.
records.criticalLimit: Callers receive only secrets allowed by their exact grant.

records.purpose: Run HTTP, dependency, image, policy, and runtime security checks in Buster.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test plan needs one of the five declared security contracts.
records.avoidWhen: Do not treat one provider result as a complete security assessment.
records.criticalLimit: Each provider covers a separate evidence source and execution environment.

records.purpose: Compare artifact size facts with a declared Buster budget.
records.useWhen: Use it when release quality depends on a bounded artifact size.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to measure runtime memory or container resource use.
records.criticalLimit: It evaluates only the supplied artifact and configured size threshold.

records.purpose: Provide controlled reads and writes for extension-owned state.
records.useWhen: Use it when a pipeline extension needs durable bounded state.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to replace Core's canonical journal.
records.criticalLimit: Keys, values, ownership, and operations remain grant-bound.

records.purpose: Create a bounded Tailscale exposure for a Buster test target.
records.useWhen: Use it when a remote test must reach an otherwise private fixture.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for permanent ingress or unrelated network access.
records.criticalLimit: It depends on Tailscale authority and must clean up the temporary exposure.

records.purpose: Deliver committed lifecycle telemetry through the configured telemetry path.
records.useWhen: Use it when pipeline events need an asynchronous telemetry projection.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it to store canonical pipeline state or gate execution.
records.criticalLimit: Telemetry delivery can fail without changing the committed source event.

records.purpose: Provide bounded telemetry storage operations to approved consumers.
records.useWhen: Use it when runtime roles must persist or query declared telemetry records.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a general database or pipeline journal.
records.criticalLimit: Record shape, query scope, and retention depend on adapter grants and configuration.

records.purpose: Publish bounded messages through the selected transport capability.
records.useWhen: Use it when a Nova extension needs transport-neutral message publication.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it when a package requires Redis-specific telemetry behavior.
records.criticalLimit: The selected provider and grant determine the real transport authority.

records.purpose: Run visual comparison checks and produce bounded image evidence in Buster.
records.useWhen: Use it when a test plan must detect changes against approved visual baselines.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it for functional browser interaction without visual comparison.
records.criticalLimit: Results depend on stable rendering conditions and the selected baseline.

records.purpose: Persist and resolve durable wait records for Nova stages.
records.useWhen: Use it when a stage pauses for an external condition or decision.
records.avoidWhen: Do not use it as a general state database or busy-wait mechanism.
records.criticalLimit: Wait identity and resolution remain bound to the owning pipeline context.
